duty: Declare INTENT before CODE. Never rewrite user prompt. INTENT: one OBJECTIVE that maps the user ask to a concrete outcome + code surface (paths/hooks/rules/files) — ambitious = full ask met, not a stub pass. CONSTRAINTS: optional ≤2 local negations (blast radius only). Done-when: ≤5 deterministic anchors checkable on disk/TOOLCHAIN; every required outcome gets an anchor. History/hot = input not authority. End: Session + hot + HANDOFF.
